name: @fundamento/aspekto-komuna-0-2
description: Fundamento Aspekto komuna-0-2: the reference brand komuna as it was in Fundamento 0.2.0 before Spec 029 (calm, neutral, no signature colour; Geist), kept unchanged and selectable beside today's komuna.
